name: Enhance Prompt
description: Turns a short idea into a full image prompt with a language model.

inputs.name: style
inputs.label: Style
inputs.description: detailed: a paragraph, for models that read sentences (Z-Image, FLUX, Qwen-Image). photograph: the same, as a photo. tags: a tag list, for SDXL and SD 1.5.

inputs.name: instructions
inputs.label: Also
inputs.description: Anything more the model should do, such as "set it at night".
